opening.argument: The video is framed as straightforward India TV reporting on disorder and an alleged confrontation inside the Karnataka assembly. Its headline identifies the subject as a “Ruckus in Karnataka assembly,” while the report attributes alleged mistreatment of the deputy chairman to Congress members, stating that they “misbehaved with the Deputy Chairman Dharmingora” and “pressured him out of his chair.” Assembly footage, a reporter on camera, and the broadcast headlines reinforce a news format. The subscription language is ordinary channel engagement and is not connected to a solicitation or deceptive transaction.
